title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 11: Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 2)

lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Ethnic groups of Vietnam (Set 2) ngay nhé!

(Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.)

Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the conversation. Emma: Hey Jake, did you learn anything interesting about the ethnic groups in Vietnam during your trip? Jake: Yeah, it was amazing! I visited a village in the 17.1  and saw how they live. I saw them 17.2 beautiful fabrics by hand. Emma: That sounds so cool! Do they use the fabrics for their clothes? Jake: Yes, and they also sell them to tourists. It helps them earn money to 17.3 their families. Emma: What about their daily life? What do they usually do? Jake: Well, everyone works together. The adults focus on farming, while kids help with 17.4 like cleaning and cooking. Emma: That’s nice. Did they 17.5 you to try any of their crafts? Jake: Yes, they let me try weaving, but it’s harder than it looks! They were really kind and patient with me.
